name: AMPL Capital Limited
about: AMPL Capital Limited operates as a non-deposit accepting non-banking financial company in India and United Kingdom. The company engages in granting loans, making investments; and providing portfolio management services. It also offers investment banking services, such as financial assessment, capital market, credit realignment, private equity, and mergers and acquisitions, as well as real estate advisory services. In addition, the company offers non-bank financing services including secured business loans. It serves SMEs. The company was formerly known as Credent Global Finance Limited and changed its name to AMPL Capital Limited in June 2026. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Mumbai, India.
